markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 系动词像一个**等号**：它不说「做了什么」，只说主语**是什么样、好像什么样、变成什么样**。be 是最常见的，还有 seem、become、get、stay 这些。

uses.en_zh: 今天 App 好像很慢。

adj.title: 后面跟形容词
adj.rule: 系动词后面说的是**主语的样子**，所以用形容词（happy、quiet），不用副词（happily、quietly）。

examples.zh: 大家好像都对演示很满意。

examples.en: She [[became]] a team lead last year.

seem.title: seem / appear：好像
seem.rule: seem 和 appear 都是「**好像、看来**」，说的是你的印象，不一定对。appear 更正式，常出现在邮件和报告里。

examples.zh: 她好像认识这里的每个人。

examples.en: [[It seems that]] the API has changed.

notes: 两种说法意思一样：[[It seems that]] he's busy. = He [[seems to be]] busy.
说过去好像发生了什么，用 seem to have done：He [[seems to have left]].（他好像已经走了。）

become.title: 变成：get / become / go / turn
become.rule: 都是「变得」：**get** 最口语；**become** 更正式；**go** 多说变坏（go wrong、go bad）；**turn** 常说颜色。

examples.en: It[['s getting]] late. Let's go home.

stay.title: 保持：stay / remain / keep
stay.rule: 说「一直保持这样」，用 **stay**、**keep**，正式一点用 **remain**。后面一样跟形容词。

twoway.title: 同一个词，两种用法
twoway.rule: look、feel、taste、get 也能当普通动作。判断方法：**能换成 is，意思还通**，就是系动词，用形容词；换不了，就是动作，用副词。

items.rule: 能换成 is：系动词 + 形容词
换不了 is：动作 + 副词
能换成 is：系动词 + 形容词
换不了 is：「得到」的意思

this.meaning: seem：整体印象，可能是听说、推断的

commonMistakes.why: seem 本身就是动词，前面不用再加 is。
seem 后面接动作用 to do。
日常小变化，口语用 get 更自然。

quiz.prompt: It's ___ cold. You should take a coat.

quiz.explain: stay 是系动词，后面用形容词 [[calm]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He seems happily with the result.
quiz.answer: He seems happy with the result.
quiz.explain: seem 后面用形容词：[[seems]] happy。

quiz.prompt: She seems ___ (know) everyone in the office.

traps.note: seem 后面用 to do，不用 -ing。

quiz.explain: seem 后面接动作用 to do：[[seems to know]]。

quiz.prompt: 改写成 He seems … 的句子：It seems that he is busy.
quiz.explain: It seems that he is… = He [[seems to be]]…

quiz.prompt: 报告里更正式的说法：The issue ___ to be fixed.
翻译：服务器好像宕机了。
quiz.answer: The server seems to be down.
accept: The server appears to be down.
It seems that the server is down.
It seems the server is down.
It appears that the server is down.
It appears the server is down.

quiz.prompt: My hair is starting to ___ grey.
Despite the changes, the price ___ (remain) the same.
quiz.explain: 主语是 the price，「保持不变」：[[remain{s}]]。
look at 是「看」这个动作，用副词 [[angrily]]。

quiz.prompt: She looked ___ when she heard the news.
quiz.explain: 能换成 she was angry，是系动词，用形容词 [[angry]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：She is seem tired today.
quiz.explain: seem 本身就是动词，不用加 is。

accept: He does not seem very happy.
He doesn't seem to be very happy.
He doesn't seem to be happy.
quiz.explain: 英语习惯把 not 放在 seem 这边：He [[doesn't seem]] happy。

openTask.prompt: 用系动词说 3 句话：一句用 seem 或 appear 说你对一件事的印象，一句用 get / become 说一个变化，一句用 stay / keep 说保持的状态。
rules: 系动词后面用形容词，不用副词
seem / appear 后面接动作用 to do，前面不加 be
openTask.note: 规则判形容词 / 副词和 seem to do（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
